status: prospective; source commit recorded before held-out execution
primary_outcome: settled citizen contract units delivered / settled citizen contract units committed
secondary_outcomes: net asset change at inventory values 1,3,6

controls.design: One-factor capacity8/capacity128 and role_policyfalse versus the reversal32 guarded_none primary cell; full2x2 stock/allocation control shares the per_capita/seeded primary baseline. Six additional worlds per seed, 180 total control worlds.

causal_checks: remove actual player claim before delivery
operator immediate correction versus paid next-tick participant inspection reported separately
inference: Average paired differences within each independent seed across the six primary cells; percentile paired bootstrap over 30 seeds, 10000 draws, fixed bootstrap seed 72831. Cells and sensitivity results are descriptive. No tick/agent independence assumption.
confirmatory_contrast: guarded_lineage minus guarded_none on delivery fill rate; two-sided 95% paired seed-bootstrap confidence interval
falsification: If the confirmatory interval includes zero, do not claim demonstrated delivery improvement. A positive information classification score is not evidence of economic benefit.
analysis_policy: Freeze source and this file before heldout. Do not tune policies against heldout outcomes. If a correctness defect is found, invalidate the affected run, record the defect and source change, and rerun all paired conditions; label this procedural deviation. Any new hypothesis after looking is exploratory.
limits: Synthetic deterministic offline economy; no real users, no LLM inference evidence, no optimal-policy regret, no social welfare estimate. Capacity is a count of experiences, not a byte budget. Old results are historical and are not merged.
